title: Recovery 1.2 - the pull-down on each strap pad (ohms)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: Resistance to GND. The black lead stays on U15 pin 4; the red lead goes on each strap pad in turn; wait until the reading settles. About 2.7 kOhm = SOP2, about 100 kOhm = SOP0 or SOP1.

callouts.label: strap pad X4, SOP0
callouts.note: The top of the three round pads below C231, right of J14. Measured: beeps to U1 pin 35 (SOP0), raptox's beeper, unpowered, 2026-11-05. Red lead here; the cap to GND on the pad makes the reading creep before it settles.

callouts.label: strap pad X5, SOP1
callouts.note: The middle of the three round pads below C231, right of J14. Measured: beeps to U1 pin 34 (SOP1), raptox's beeper, unpowered, 2026-11-05. Red lead here; the cap to GND on the pad makes the reading creep before it settles.

callouts.label: strap pad X6, SOP2
callouts.note: The bottom of the three round pads below C231, right of J14. Measured: beeps to U1 pin 21 (SOP2), raptox's beeper, unpowered, 2026-11-05. Red lead here; the cap to GND on the pad makes the reading creep before it settles.

callouts.label: U15 pin 4, GND
callouts.note: VSS (XMC datasheet rev. J); rings to JP5 pin 2 (J-080). Right end of the row nearer J14. Black lead on the foot.

callouts.label: U15 pin 1 (the dimple end)
callouts.note: CS#. Left end of the same row, next to the moulded dimple; pin 4 is three leads to its right. Not touched in this step.

terminals.label: Meter red lead (ohms): X4, X5, X6 in turn
